No power capacity, floor space, or equipment density for this facility is published. Stanford University operates the site but has not disclosed specifications that would indicate its scale or relevance to AI infrastructure demand.

The facility ranks 12th among California sites by published megawatt capacity, but this ranking reflects only that 11 sites in the state have published figures at all. Of 103 mapped data center facilities in California, only those 11 disclose power specifications, totaling 365 MW. This campus contributes an unknown share of that total, as its own capacity remains unpublished.

Without published power, cooling, or space specifications, the campus cannot be assessed against the infrastructure constraints that determine whether a facility matters to AI scaling. Researchers and investors evaluating grid-constrained AI deployment have no basis to model this site's role.
